rounds.description: Ammo rack capacity; an absent value preserves legacy volume-based inference, while zero explicitly declares an empty rack.

weapon_group.description: Mounted weapon or shared turret dependency. Existing main_launcher/launcher_mount_N names remain valid; normalized secondary assemblies use mg:<secondaryId>.

external.description: Overrides kind defaults; an internal coax receiver stays protected while its barrel is external.

turret_index.description: Parent turret index in the neutral vehicle frame; generated hull-anchored machine guns omit it.
